WHY NOTES, NOT LISTS

Guidebooks tell you what's there. Notebooks tell you what mattered.

I've spent the last several years traveling and writing everything down by hand — the restaurant that wasn't in any guide, the bus that never came. Most of it never makes it online.

Adventure Unwrapped turns those notebooks into itineraries. Not a scraped list of "top ten" attractions, but a route shaped by a real trip, adjusted to fit yours: your pace, your budget, your version of a good day.

You tell me what you're after. I hand you a plan with the fog, the wrong turns, and the good stuff already worked out.

— written trip by trip, notebook by notebook

HOW IT WORKS

From your dream trip to a plan you'll actually follow

No templates, no auto-generated lists — every itinerary is put together by hand, from real notes.

1

Tell me the trip you're after

Fill in the request below — where you're drawn to, your dates, your pace, your budget. Takes about three minutes.

2

I draft it from real notes

I pull from trips I've actually taken and build a day-by-day plan shaped around what you told me — not a generic list.

3

We refine it together

You get a draft, we adjust anything that's off, and you leave with an itinerary that's actually yours.

START YOUR TRIP

Request your itinerary

A few questions, then I'll get back to you personally — usually within a couple of days.

✈️

Where are you drawn to?

A country, a region, or just a feeling — "somewhere slow and coastal" works fine.

The practical details

This just helps me shape the plan to fit.

What's your type of trip?

e.g. culture, relaxation, party — pick as many as fit.

Anything else I should know?

Must-dos, must-avoids, dietary needs, mobility considerations — whatever matters.
